tokens.name: sc-bg-page
tokens.usage: App background behind everything: page ground, story column, marketing sections.

tokens.name: sc-bg-panel
tokens.usage: Rails, top bar, composer shell, admin sidebars. One step up from the page.

tokens.name: sc-bg-card
tokens.usage: Cards, chips, list rows, input fills.

tokens.name: sc-bg-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, peek cards, the player's turn bubble, avatar fills, selected rows.

tokens.name: sc-border
tokens.usage: Default hairline between surfaces and around cards.

tokens.name: sc-border-strong
tokens.usage: Inputs, outlined chips, secondary buttons. Meets 3:1 against panel as a control edge.

tokens.name: sc-text
tokens.usage: Primary text and prose on every surface (page, panel, card, raised).

tokens.name: sc-text-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: roles, subtitles, chip labels. Legible on every surface.

tokens.name: sc-text-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, meta lines, placeholder text, overlines. 4.5:1 minimum on panel and card; never lighter for small text.

tokens.name: sc-text-faint
tokens.usage: Decorative only: dividers' glyphs, disabled icon strokes. Never for text a player must read.

tokens.name: sc-primary
tokens.usage: Violet. Primary actions, active tab and segment, the player's voice, focus ring. Text on it uses sc-on-primary.

tokens.name: sc-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Violet text on dark grounds: NPC names and links, overlines that carry the brand.

tokens.name: sc-on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sc-primary fills (7.0:1 dark, 5.8:1 light).

tokens.name: sc-accent
tokens.usage: Teal. Mechanics, bonds, places, 'learned', Stones balance marks. As text in light theme use sc-accent-soft.

tokens.name: sc-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Teal text: place links, success words in receipts, learned lines.

tokens.name: sc-danger
tokens.usage: Health bars, combat vignette, destructive buttons. Red means health and combat only in play.

tokens.name: sc-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Red text: negative deltas (-10), error copy.

tokens.name: sc-stamina
tokens.usage: Stamina bar fill and icon.

tokens.name: sc-warn
tokens.usage: Items, partial success, pending states (starter grant pending, internal content).

tokens.name: sc-warn-soft
tokens.usage: Amber text: item links, 'partial' in receipts, pending labels.

tokens.name: sc-lore
tokens.usage: Lore terms, glossary marks.

tokens.name: sc-lore-soft
tokens.usage: Lore link text.

tokens.name: sc-faction
tokens.usage: Faction links and standing marks.

tokens.name: sc-ent-npc
tokens.usage: Character link text; paired with a dotted underline.

tokens.name: sc-ent-unknown
tokens.usage: Unidentified character link; dotted grey underline, alias only, never the true name.

tokens.name: sc-ent-place
tokens.usage: Place link; dashed underline.

tokens.name: sc-ent-item
tokens.usage: Object link; solid underline.

tokens.name: sc-ent-lore
tokens.usage: Lore term link; double underline.

tokens.name: sc-ent-faction
tokens.usage: Faction link; wavy underline.

tokens.name: sc-focus
tokens.usage: Addition: keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with a 2px page-colour gap. 3:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: sc-scrim
tokens.usage: Addition: dim layer behind the Codex modal, sheets and confirm dialogs.

styles.name: sc-hero
styles.sample: Cast your stone. Begin a story.
styles.usage: Addition for marketing: landing hero only, once per page.

styles.name: sc-title-lg
styles.usage: Page titles: story detail, My Stories, Casting Circle step titles.

styles.name: sc-title
styles.usage: Card and section titles, scene card, dossier header.

styles.name: sc-name
styles.usage: Character names in rails, cast cards, peek cards, story card titles.

styles.name: sc-prose
styles.sample: Rain has drummed on the Gilded Stag's shutters for an hour.

styles.name: sc-prose-mobile
styles.sample: Kiera's smile doesn't reach her eyes.

styles.name: sc-lede
styles.sample: A grounded high fantasy of ward-scarred forests.
styles.usage: Story and world blurbs on catalog pages.

styles.name: sc-body
styles.sample: Pick up where you left off.
styles.usage: UI body: forms, lists, settings, admin tables.

styles.name: sc-small
styles.usage: Meta lines, card subtitles, helper text.

styles.name: sc-overline
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and speaker names. The smallest UI text allowed.

styles.name: sc-mono
styles.usage: Mechanics chips, receipts, rolls, Stones amounts in ledgers, content keys.

styles.name: sc-mono-xs
styles.usage: Hashes, request IDs and turn counters in admin views.

spacing.note: 4px base. Lay siblings out with gap, not margins.

tokens.name: sc-space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, delta chip padding.

tokens.name: sc-space-2
tokens.usage: Chip row gap, tight stacks.

tokens.name: sc-space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner gaps, field label to input.

tokens.name: sc-space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: sc-space-5
tokens.usage: Section gaps inside rails, between turn blocks.

tokens.name: sc-space-6
tokens.usage: Page section gaps, desktop gutter.

tokens.name: sc-space-7
tokens.usage: Marketing section rhythm.

tokens.name: sc-radius-control
tokens.usage: Addition: buttons, inputs, segmented control, mono chips.

tokens.name: sc-radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, composer, peek popovers, story cards.

tokens.name: sc-radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of mobile bottom sheets and the Codex modal.

tokens.name: sc-radius-chip
tokens.usage: Suggestion chips, pills, avatars, send button.

size.note: Layout measures from SPEC section 4 and the 44px touch rule.

tokens.name: sc-tap
tokens.usage: Minimum interactive target on every device.

tokens.name: sc-header-h
tokens.usage: Top bar height, app and play.

tokens.name: sc-rail-left
tokens.usage: Character rail width at 1440.

tokens.name: sc-rail-right
tokens.usage: Here rail width at 1440; slim avatar rail at 1100.

tokens.name: sc-measure
tokens.usage: Prose column max width.

tokens.name: sc-shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Peek popovers, menus, the floating critical bar. Cards stay flat and use a hairline.

tokens.name: sc-shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom sheets and the Codex modal.
